data.one_liner: Annotation-driven route generator and navigation helper for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Scans Dart code for annotations like @FFRoute to generate strongly-typed routing maps and argument helpers. It supports multiple navigation frameworks including Navigator 1.0/2.0, GetX, and GoRouter, alongside route interceptors and lifecycle observers.
use_when: You want strongly-typed routing and arguments generated via annotations
Your project uses Navigator 1.0, 2.0, GetX, or GoRouter and needs centralized route maps
You need built-in route interceptors and page lifecycle callbacks
avoid_when: You prefer manual route table definitions without code generation tools
You do not want external command-line tools or global activation in your build workflow
strengths: Strongly-typed argument helpers and auto-import features
Supports fast mode and full analysis mode for monorepos
weaknesses: Requires running an external CLI command for route generation
Fast mode requires manual import statements or @FFAutoImport for complex arguments
data.setup_notes: Activate the plugin globally using `dart pub global activate ff_annotation_route`, add dependencies like ff_annotation_route_core and ff_annotation_route_library, and execute the route generator command in the project root.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust, annotation-driven routing solution with built-in declarative routing and generated type-safe arguments.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers an official declarative routing package with deep linking built directly into the Flutter ecosystem without mandatory code generation tools.
